## device.settings — Read device settings

- WEB: **supported**. `GET /api/settings/read`
- CLI: **supported**. `settings view`; `settings get`
- SDK: **supported**. `Client.SettingsView`; `Client.Settings`

Models: ultra, lite.
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `read`.
Requirement mode: `fixed`. Unconditional commands: `1034 GET_DEVICE_SETTINGS`.

Web returns a redacted SettingsView. Sleep/threshold getters are optional probes and unsupported fields remain unknown.

In native maintenance mode this read supports pairing inspection/readback. General settings changes remain on the Python bridge.

Sources: [settings_view.go](../settings_view.go), [settings.go](../settings.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go).

## device.configure — Configure device settings

- WEB: **supported**. `POST /api/settings/configure`; `POST /api/features/check`
- CLI: **supported**. `settings configure`; `settings set`
- SDK: **supported**. `Client.ConfigureSettings`

Models: ultra, lite.
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `parameter-dependent`.
Requirement mode: `parameterized`. Unconditional commands: None.

- animation: `1016 GET_ANIMATION_MODE`, `1015 SET_ANIMATION_MODE`
- sleep: `1039 GET_SLEEP_TIMEOUT`, `1040 SET_SLEEP_TIMEOUT`
- long-press threshold: `1041 GET_LONG_PRESS_THRESHOLD`, `1042 SET_LONG_PRESS_THRESHOLD`
- short/long buttons: `1026 GET_BUTTON_PRESS_CONFIG`, `1027 SET_BUTTON_PRESS_CONFIG`, `1028 GET_LONG_BUTTON_PRESS_CONFIG`, `1029 SET_LONG_BUTTON_PRESS_CONFIG`
- save: `1013 SAVE_SETTINGS`

Selected settings expand exact getter/setter and final-read/save requirements. PIN/pairing changes require direct serial. Web submits background tasks and never retries writes.

Native USB maintenance accepts pairing-only patches. Ordinary and mixed patches require the Python bridge; a bridge still cannot change pairing.

Sources: [settings_workflow.go](../settings_workflow.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_configuration.go).

## device.pairing — Pairing PIN, policy and bonds

- WEB: **partial**. `POST /api/settings/configure`

- SDK: **supported**. `Client.SetBLEKey`; `Client.SetBLEPairing`; `Client.ClearBLEBonds`

Models: ultra, lite.
Transport policy: `pairing`. Effect: `parameter-dependent`.
Requirement mode: `parameterized`. Unconditional commands: None.

- PIN: `1030 SET_BLE_PAIRING_KEY`
- pairing policy: `1037 SET_BLE_PAIRING_ENABLE`
- delete bonds: `1032 DELETE_ALL_BLE_BONDS`

Web supports PIN and pairing policy through settings; bond clearing has no Web entry.

Native CLI operations require --native-usb and an explicit physical application port. SDK callers use OpenNativeUSBContext; USB bridge restrictions remain in force.

Sources: [settings.go](../settings.go), [transport_info.go](../transport_info.go).

- WEB: **partial**. `POST /api/database`

Web supports list/show/add/delete/validate, read-result import and name/data editing. Merge and folder workflows have no dedicated Web entry.

Read drafts preserve source results, offsets and unknown-byte masks. Unconverted drafts cannot be loaded into slots, used as NDEF cards or converted to binary/emulator images; export Desk JSON.

Editing does not resolve unknown bytes, infer Type2 capacity or establish a complete HF identity.

## library.promote-classic — Convert a complete Classic read draft to a standard saved card

- WEB: **supported**. `POST /api/database`; `POST /api/features/check`
- CLI: **supported**. `read-draft promote --kind classic`
- SDK: **supported**. `GUICard.ClassicPromotionError`; `GUICard.PromoteClassicDraft`

Models: ultra, lite (device-independent).
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `offline`.
Requirement mode: `parameterized`. Unconditional commands: None.

Offline conversion requires a complete Classic read, observed identity, full memory, known keys and consistent block 0 / trailer access bytes.

Creates a new saved card and retains the original draft. Does not write a device or physical card.

Legacy drafts without identity, partial/error sources, unresolved masks and invalid geometry are rejected. Merge evidence retains every source and requires a successful full read authority.

Sources: [classic_identity.go](../classic_identity.go), [classic_promotion.go](../classic_promotion.go).

## library.promote-slot — Convert a complete slot snapshot to a standard saved card

- WEB: **supported**. `POST /api/database (promote-slot)`; `POST /api/features/check`
- CLI: **supported**. `read-draft promote --kind slot`; `database promote-read --kind slot`

Models: ultra, lite (device-independent).
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `offline`.
Requirement mode: `parameterized`. Unconditional commands: None.

Offline, explicit conversion requires a complete error-free slot snapshot, captured identity and valid source and edited memory. Partial results and unknown bytes cannot be promoted.

Classic requires matching block-0 UID, supported identity/geometry and valid trailer access bytes. Type2 requires matching UID/BCC and modeled geometry; known emulator credentials remain exact bytes. LF uses the existing protocol codecs; edited ioProx requires firmware validation and is rejected here.

Creates a new saved card, preserving the source draft and uncaptured scope in desk_read_origin. Configuration, Type2 version/signature/counters and physical-source provenance are not inferred.

Slot loading uses its existing separate checks and is not a full configuration restore. No physical-card write handoff is added; the saved-card LF writer rejects slot-derived sources.

- CLI: **supported**. `bridge status`; `bridge scan`; `bridge select`; `bridge connect`; `bridge disconnect`

Requires a configured managed USB/BLE bridge. Connection control is serialized with device tasks and does not require card-write permission. No automatic reconnect, protocol command or native fallback.

Sources: [cmd/chameleon/bridge_cli.go](../cmd/chameleon/bridge_cli.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve_bridge.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_bridge.go), [bridge_control.go](../bridge_control.go).

## environment.diagnostics — Core, worker and managed bridge environment diagnosis

- WEB: **supported**. `GET /api/environment`
- CLI: **supported**. `environment doctor`
- SDK: **supported**. `DiagnoseEnvironment`; `DiagnoseRecovery`; `DefaultRecoveryToolsDir`

Models: any (device-independent).
Transport policy: `any`. Effect: `read`.
Requirement mode: `fixed`. Unconditional commands: None.

Inspects only server-configured worker files and optional authenticated management status. It does not run workers, open hardware or send firmware commands.

Companions are paired by native platform, release, compatibility and known revision, with per-worker hashes. Unversioned local workers and loader/hardware readiness remain unverified.

Bridge-host Python imports, bind availability and OS permissions require its separate local Python doctor. No browser-selected executable paths or tokens.

Sources: [environment_diagnostics.go](../environment_diagnostics.go), [recovery_diagnostics.go](../recovery_diagnostics.go), [cmd/chameleon/serve_environment.go](../cmd/chameleon/serve_environment.go), [scripts/build_recovery.py](../scripts/build_recovery.py).
